name: Tomato Bath
steps: Dry-roast semolina for 4 minutes until fragrant but pale, then spread it on a plate to cool.
Heat the measured oil in a wide pan, splutter mustard and curry leaves, then soften chopped onion, chilli and ginger for 4–5 minutes over medium heat.
Add chopped tomato and turmeric to the softened aromatics and cook for 6–8 minutes until the tomatoes collapse into a thick red base; toast cashews separately.
Add 650 ml boiling water and the measured salt. Sprinkle in roasted semolina slowly while stirring, cover and cook 4–5 minutes until the grains are soft but not gluey.
Switch off the heat, fluff gently and finish with chopped coriander. Divide into four bowls and serve warm; avoid packing down the grains. Top each bowl with the toasted cashews.
tips: Cook the tomatoes down before adding water for a concentrated tomato flavor.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
